verses.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְצֵ֥את בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·lî·šî lə·ṣêṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim bay·yō·wm haz·zeh bā·’ū miḏ·bar sî·nāy
verses.literal: In the third month on the same day of the month that the Israelites . . . had left the land of Egypt they came to the Wilderness of Sinai
verses.literalPt: No terceiro mês, depois que os filhos de Israel haviam saído da terra do Egito, no mesmo dia entraram no deserto de Sinai.

verses.original: וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵרְפִידִ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּֽחַן־ שָׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נֶ֥גֶד הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·‘ū mê·rə·p̄î·ḏîm way·yā·ḇō·’ū miḏ·bar sî·nay way·ya·ḥă·nū bam·miḏ·bār way·yi·ḥan- šām yiś·rā·’êl ne·ḡeḏ hā·hār
verses.literal: After they had set out from Rephidim they entered the Wilderness of Sinai and Israel camped there in front of the mountain
verses.literalPt: Tendo, pois, partido de Refidim, chegaram ao deserto de Sinai, em que se acamparam; ali, se acampou Israel em frente do monte.

verses.original: וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ מִן־ הָהָ֣ר לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לְבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתַגֵּ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mō·šeh ‘ā·lāh ’el- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiq·rā ’ê·lāw Yah·weh min- hā·hār lê·mōr kōh ṯō·mar lə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·ṯag·gêḏ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then Moses went up to God and the LORD called to him from the mountain This is what . . . you are to tell the house of Jacob and explain to the sons of Israel
verses.literalPt: Subiu Moisés a Deus, e do monte Jeová o chamou, dizendo: Assim falarás à casa de Jacó e anunciarás aos filhos de Israel:

verses.original: אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְמִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ עַל־ כַּנְפֵ֣י נְשָׁרִ֔ים וָאָבִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem rə·’î·ṯem ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·miṣ·rā·yim wā·’eś·śā ’eṯ·ḵem ‘al- kan·p̄ê nə·šā·rîm wā·’ā·ḇi ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: You have seen for yourselves what I did to Egypt and how I carried you on eagles’ wings and brought you to Myself
verses.literalPt: Tendes visto o que fiz aos egípcios, de que modo vos trouxe sobre asas de águias e vos cheguei a mim.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־ שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּקֹלִ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֑י וִהְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִכָּל־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כִּי־ לִ֖י כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’im- šā·mō·w·a‘ tiš·mə·‘ū bə·qō·lî ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî wih·yî·ṯem lî sə·ḡul·lāh mik·kāl hā·‘am·mîm kî- lî kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Now if you will indeed obey . . . My voice and keep My covenant you will be My treasured possession out of all the nations for the whole earth is Mine
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, se atentamente ouvirdes a minha voz e guardardes a minha aliança, sereis a minha possessão peculiar dentre todos os povos (pois minha é toda a terra)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ־ לִ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְג֣וֹי קָד֑וֹשׁ אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem tih·yū- lî mam·le·ḵeṯ kō·hă·nîm wə·ḡō·w qā·ḏō·wōš ’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer tə·ḏab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And unto Me you shall be a kingdom of priests and a holy nation These are the words that you are to speak to the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: e vós me sereis reino de sacerdotes e nação santa. Estas são as palavras que falarás aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְזִקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh way·yiq·rā lə·ziq·nê hā·‘ām way·yā·śem lip̄·nê·hem ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·hū Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses went back and summoned the elders of the people and set before them all these words that the LORD had commanded him
verses.literalPt: Veio Moisés e, convocados os anciãos do povo, expôs-lhes todas essas palavras que Jeová lhe ordenara.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ כָל־ הָעָ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיָּ֧שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nū ḵāl hā·‘ām yaḥ·dāw way·yō·mə·rū kōl ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh na·‘ă·śeh way·yā·šeḇ mō·šeh ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hā·‘ām ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: And all the people answered together . . . We will do everything that the LORD has spoken So Moses brought their words back to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Todo o povo respondeu a uma voz: Tudo o que Jeová tem falado faremos. Referiu Moisés a Jeová as palavras do povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶיךָ֮ בְּעַ֣ב הֶֽעָנָן֒ בַּעֲב֞וּר יִשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ בְּדַבְּרִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־ בְּךָ֖ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַיַּגֵּ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî bā ’ê·le·ḵā bə·‘aḇ he·‘ā·nān ba·‘ă·ḇūr yiš·ma‘ hā·‘ām bə·ḏab·bə·rî ‘im·māḵ wə·ḡam- bə·ḵā ya·’ă·mî·nū lə·‘ō·w·lām way·yag·gêḏ mō·šeh ’eṯ- diḇ·rê hā·‘ām ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: The LORD said to Moses Behold I will come to you in a dense cloud so that the people will hear when I speak with you and they will always put their trust in you And Moses relayed to the LORD what the people had said
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Jeová a Moisés: Eis que venho ter contigo em uma nuvem espessa, para que o povo ouça quando eu falar contigo e para que também te creia para sempre. Referiu Moisés a Jeová as palavras do povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ם הַיּ֖וֹם וּמָחָ֑ר וְכִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lêḵ ’el- hā·‘ām wə·qid·daš·tām hay·yō·wm ū·mā·ḥār wə·ḵib·bə·sū śim·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go . . . to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow They must wash their clothes
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Vai ter com o povo e santifica-os hoje e amanhã. Lavem os seus vestidos

verses.original: וְהָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֣י׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י יֵרֵ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־ הָעָ֖ם עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū nə·ḵō·nîm lay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî kî bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî yê·rêḏ Yah·weh lə·‘ê·nê ḵāl hā·‘ām ‘al- har sî·nāy
verses.literal: and be prepared by the third day for on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai in the sight of all the people
verses.literalPt: e estejam prontos para o terceiro dia, porque, no terceiro dia, descerá Jeová à vista de todo o povo sobre o monte Sinai.

verses.original: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵאמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם עֲל֥וֹת בָּהָ֖ר וּנְגֹ֣עַ בְּקָצֵ֑הוּ כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהָ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḡ·bal·tā ’eṯ- hā·‘ām sā·ḇîḇ lê·mōr hiš·šā·mə·rū lā·ḵem ‘ă·lō·wṯ bā·hār ū·nə·ḡō·a‘ bə·qā·ṣê·hū kāl- han·nō·ḡê·a‘ bā·hār mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: And you are to set up a boundary for the people around the mountain and tell them Be careful not to go up on the mountain or touch its base Whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Marcarás em roda limites ao povo, dizendo: Guardai-vos, não subais ao monte, nem toqueis o seu termo; todo o que tocar o monte certamente será morto.

verses.original: לֹא־ תִגַּ֨ע בּ֜וֹ יָ֗ד כִּֽי־ סָק֤וֹל יִסָּקֵל֙ אוֹ־ יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם־ בְּהֵמָ֥ה אִם־ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה בִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הַיֹּבֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯig·ga‘ bōw yāḏ kî- sā·qō·wl yis·sā·qêl ’ōw- yā·rōh yî·yā·reh ’im- bə·hê·māh ’im- ’îš lō yiḥ·yeh bim·šōḵ hay·yō·ḇêl hêm·māh ya·‘ă·lū ḇā·hār
verses.literal: No hand shall touch him but he shall surely be stoned . . . or shot with arrows whether man or beast he must not live Only when the ram’s horn sounds a long blast may they approach the mountain
verses.literalPt: Mão alguma tocará naquele que o fizer, mas ele será apedrejado ou asseteado; quer seja animal, quer seja homem, não viverá. Quando se prolongar o som da buzina, subirão eles ao monte.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִן־ הָהָ֖ר אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ mō·šeh min- hā·hār ’el- hā·‘ām way·qad·dêš ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·ḵab·bə·sū śim·lō·ṯām
verses.literal: When Moses came down from the mountain to the people he consecrated them - and they washed their clothes
verses.literalPt: Moisés, tendo descido do monte, foi ter com o povo e o santificou; e lavaram os seus vestidos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֔ם הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים אַֽל־ תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל־ אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- hā·‘ām hĕ·yū nə·ḵō·nîm liš·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm ’al- tig·gə·šū ’el- ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: Be prepared for the third day he said to the people Do not draw near to a woman
verses.literalPt: Disse ao povo: Estai prontos para o terceiro dia e não vos chegueis a mulher.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיֹ֣ת הַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְהִי֩ קֹלֹ֨ת וּבְרָקִ֜ים וְעָנָ֤ן כָּבֵד֙ עַל־ הָהָ֔ר וְקֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî bih·yōṯ hab·bō·qer way·hî qō·lōṯ ū·ḇə·rā·qîm wə·‘ā·nān kā·ḇêḏ ‘al- hā·hār wə·qōl šō·p̄ār ḥā·zāq mə·’ōḏ way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ kāl- hā·‘ām ’ă·šer bam·ma·ḥă·neh
verses.literal: On the third day when morning . . . came there was thunder and lightning A thick cloud was upon the mountain and a very loud . . . blast of the ram’s horn went out so that all the people in the camp trembled
verses.literalPt: Ao terceiro dia, depois de raiar o dia, houve trovões e relâmpagos. Uma nuvem espessa cobriu o monte, e ouviu-se um sonido de buzina mui forte; estremeceu todo o povo que estava no arraial.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־ הָעָ֛ם לִקְרַ֥את הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּתַחְתִּ֥ית הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣê mō·šeh ’eṯ- hā·‘ām liq·raṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm min- ham·ma·ḥă·neh way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū bə·ṯaḥ·tîṯ hā·hār
verses.literal: Then Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet with God and they stood at the foot of the mountain
verses.literalPt: Moisés levou o povo fora do arraial ao encontro de Deus; e pararam ao pé do monte.

verses.original: וְהַ֤ר סִינַי֙ עָשַׁ֣ן כֻּלּ֔וֹ מִ֠פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛יו יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַיַּ֤עַל עֲשָׁנוֹ֙ כְּעֶ֣שֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁ֔ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־ הָהָ֖ר מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·har sî·nay ‘ā·šan kul·lōw mip·pə·nê ’ă·šer yā·raḏ ‘ā·lāw Yah·weh bā·’êš way·ya·‘al ‘ă·šā·nōw kə·‘e·šen hak·kiḇ·šān way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ kāl- hā·hār mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke because the LORD had descended on it in fire And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace and the whole mountain quaked violently
verses.literalPt: O monte Sinai, todo ele, fumegava, porque Jeová tinha descido a ele em fogo; do monte subiu o fumo, como o fumo de uma fornalha, e o monte tremia grandemente.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר הוֹלֵ֖ךְ וְחָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥נּוּ בְקֽוֹל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî qō·wl haš·šō·w·p̄ār hō·w·lêḵ wə·ḥā·zêq mə·’ōḏ mō·šeh yə·ḏab·bêr wə·hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ya·‘ă·nen·nū ḇə·qō·wl
verses.literal: And as the sound of the ram’s horn grew louder . . . and louder Moses spoke and God answered him in the thunder
verses.literalPt: Quando o sonido da buzina se ia aumentando cada vez mais, falava Moisés, e respondia-lhe Deus por uma voz.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֧רֶד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י אֶל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְמֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָ֖ר וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ Yah·weh ‘al- har sî·nay ’el- rōš hā·hār way·yiq·rā Yah·weh lə·mō·šeh ’el- rōš hā·hār way·ya·‘al mō·šeh
verses.literal: The LORD descended to the top of Mount Sinai and called Moses to the summit . . . So Moses went up
verses.literalPt: Desceu Jeová sobre o monte Sinai, ao cume do monte, e chamou Moisés ao cume do monte. Moisés subiu,

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם פֶּן־ יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְנָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh rêḏ hā·‘êḏ bā·‘ām pen- ye·her·sū ’el- Yah·weh lir·’ō·wṯ wə·nā·p̄al mim·men·nū rāḇ
verses.literal: and the LORD . . . said to him Go down and warn the people not to break through . . . to see the LORD lest many of them perish
verses.literalPt: e disse Jeová a Moisés: Desce, adverte ao povo, para que não suceda que passem além dos limites a Jeová, a fim de ver, e muitos deles pereçam.

verses.original: וְגַ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַנִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן־ יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam hak·kō·hă·nîm han·nig·gā·šîm ’el- Yah·weh yiṯ·qad·dā·šū pen- yip̄·rōṣ bā·hem Yah·weh
verses.literal: Even the priests who approach . . . the LORD must consecrate themselves or the LORD will break out against them
verses.literalPt: Os sacerdotes também que se chegam a Jeová, santifiquem-se a si mesmos, para que Jeová não os fira.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ יְהוָ֔ה לֹא־ יוּכַ֣ל הָעָ֔ם לַעֲלֹ֖ת אֶל־ הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת־ הָהָ֖ר וְקִדַּשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh ’el- Yah·weh lō- yū·ḵal hā·‘ām la·‘ă·lōṯ ’el- har sî·nāy kî- ’at·tāh ha·‘ê·ḏō·ṯāh bā·nū lê·mōr haḡ·bêl ’eṯ- hā·hār wə·qid·daš·tōw
verses.literal: But Moses said to the LORD The people cannot . . . come up . . . Mount Sinai for You solemnly warned us . . . Put a boundary around the mountain and set it apart as holy
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Moisés a Jeová: O povo não poderá subir ao monte; pois tu nos ordenaste expressamente, dizendo: Marca limites ao redor do monte e santifica-o.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ לֶךְ־ רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־ יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן־ יִפְרָץ־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw Yah·weh leḵ- rêḏ wə·‘ā·lî·ṯā ’at·tāh wə·’a·hă·rōn ‘im·māḵ wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hā·‘ām ’al- ye·her·sū la·‘ă·lōṯ ’el- Yah·weh pen- yip̄·rāṣ- bām
verses.literal: And the LORD replied Go down and bring Aaron with you But the priests and the people must not break through to come up to the LORD or He will break out against them
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhe Jeová: Vai, desce. Subirás tu, e Arão, contigo; porém não passem além dos limites os sacerdotes e o povo, para subir a Jeová, para que não suceda que os fira.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רֶד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·reḏ mō·šeh ’el- hā·‘ām way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: So Moses went down to the people and spoke to them
verses.literalPt: Desceu, pois, Moisés ao povo e disse-lhes isso.
